description: This file is an abstract Java test class for testing message consumers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. It sets up and verifies behaviors of message processing actors, including inbound message handling, acknowledgment processing, and error conditions. It utilizes Akka actors, Mockito for mocking, and JUnit for testing.

classes.name: AbstractConsumerActorTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class designed for testing message-consuming actors in Eclipse Ditto. It provides setup, teardown, and utility methods for verifying message processing and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes static resources like the Akka actor system and protocol adapter provider before all tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up a test probe actor before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the Akka actor system and disables logging after all tests.

methods.name: testInboundMessage
methods.description: Test helper method to simulate inbound messages and verify correct processing.

methods.name: verifyMessageSettlement
methods.description: Abstract method intended to verify whether messages were successfully processed or failed, and whether redelivery is required.
